verdict.rationale: Airwallex publishes extensive first-party API documentation, an official CLI, scoped API keys, webhooks, sandbox environment, and quickstarts, and these are corroborated by independent probes (CLI installer works, MCP endpoint live). This clearly satisfies 'documented public API to drive the product' for an AI-native user, with AgentOS/MCP adding agent-specific tooling on top. Missing for 10: independent third-party developer reviews/blog posts confirming real-world API integration experience beyond vendor docs and probes.
